_why: Chosen 2026-11-17 from Artificial Analysis arenas. Run `rs models` to re-check the live OpenRouter catalog. Override any key in ~/ReelStudio/config.json.

tts._why: Speech Arena Elo 1340 (#1), half the price of eleven-v4 (1338). $40 / 1M chars.
tts._voice_why: ElevenLabs needs an explicit voice; this premade id (George) tested OK in Italian. Set brand.voice.voice to any ElevenLabs voice id.

image._why: Default: T2I arena Elo 1214 (#3-5) at ~$0.035/img, accepts up to 5 reference images for style consistency.
image._hero_why: Elo 1261 (#1) at quality=max, ~$0.13-0.21/img, up to 16 references. Use for the cover, the hook and mascot shots.

stt._why: Tested 2026-11-17: the only OpenRouter STT that returned word-level timestamps (WER 3.4%, ~$0.00007/scene). voxtral-small (2.1% WER) rejects word timestamps; grok-stt / voxtral-mini returned empty bodies.
